prompt: We just raised angel funding. Should we give real shares, options, or virtual stock to our first 10 employees?
expected_behavior: Recommend real shares/options for 10 employees, 4-year vesting, 10-15% pool, switch to virtual/TUP at 50+ headcount.

prompt: Our company is 12 years old. Early employees act like landlords collecting rent. How do we fix this without legal war?
expected_behavior: Advise against confiscation; introduce TUP funded before ESOP, cap new ESOP grants, create new business lines with separate TUP pools.

prompt: We may not make payroll in 3 months. Can we use equity to survive?
expected_behavior: Propose salary-to-TUP conversion, retention ESOP for critical roles, transparent updates, convertible notes, recovery triggers.
